correctness.rationale: Parity blocking and a trace-class denominator replacement reduce the coefficient to the Weyl law on the trivial rank-two bundle over the circle. Only positive cotangent directions contribute. Subtracting the elliptic logarithm and rationalizing the remainder gives an integrable uniform bound and the formula for the finite part.
residual_risks: Finite checks do not certify either limit. No joint scaling limit is established.
